\\mathcal A: the given family of subsets of [n] in which no distinct member contains another
\\mathfrak S_n: the set of all permutations of [n]
\\pi_i: the entry in position i of the permutation \pi
I_j(\\pi): the set of the first j entries of \pi, with I_0(\pi)=\varnothing
j: an integer index satisfying 0\le j\le n
\\mathcal P: the set of pairs (A,\pi) with A\in\mathcal A and A=I_{|A|}(\pi)
k: the cardinality |A| of a fixed set A
\\mathcal B: the family of all m-element subsets of [n]
